feeAndWaiverAsDelivered.destinationName: Clerk of the circuit court of the locality where the case was disposed of
feeAndWaiverAsDelivered.destinationDetail: File the petition with no court fees or costs, identifying the ancillary matter specifically and showing that the underlying charge or conviction has been sealed. Serve the attorney for the Commonwealth and request CCRE forwarding as on every Chapter 23.2 petition.
feeAndWaiverAsDelivered.feeStatement: none. Sections 19.2-392.12(B) and 19.2-392.12:1(C) provide that no court fees or costs are charged for a sealing petition, and the 2025 acts repealed the Sealing Fee Fund. The CCRE charges its own fee for the participant's own copy of their criminal history record, which is a separate cost.
feeAndWaiverAsDelivered.feeWaiverStatement: none — no court fee is charged, so there is nothing to waive.

selfHelpStopConditionsAsDelivered: The underlying charge or conviction has not in fact been sealed, which is the whole of the subsection J test.
It is unclear which automatic-sealing section reached the underlying matter, because the offence-date floor applies to two of the three.
The attorney for the Commonwealth objects or answers.
